title: TTGBench: Benchmarking Topological Evolution and Semantic Drift in Text-attributed Temporal Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2609.08226v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temporal graph learning models the evolution of dynamic systems, where both structural interactions and semantic states change over time. However, existing benchmarks primarily emphasize structural evolution via temporal link prediction (TLP), while support for semantic evolution remains limited. Although temporal node classification (TNC) is sometimes included, it is typically restricted to simplistic binary settings that fail to capture realistic semantic drift. Moreover, commonly used datasets exhibit high link repetition, leading to inflated performance estimates and obscuring true model capability. To address these limitations, we introduce \textbf{TTGBench}, a new benchmark that jointly evaluates structural and semantic evolution. TTGBench comprises six real-world, text-rich datasets characterized by \emph{Dual Volatility}, enabling rigorous and fair evaluation of existing models. translated_title: TTGBench：面向文本属性时序图中拓扑演化与语义漂移的基准测试
translated_abstract: 时序图学习旨在对动态系统的演化过程进行建模，其中结构交互和语义状态都会随时间发生变化。然而，现有基准主要通过时序链路预测（TLP）侧重于结构演化，而对语义演化的支持仍然有限。尽管有时也会包含时序节点分类（TNC），但通常仅限于过于简单的二分类设置，无法捕捉现实中的语义漂移。此外，常用的数据集存在较高的链路重复率，导致性能估计被夸大，掩盖了模型的真实能力。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 TTGBench，这是一个能够联合评估结构演化与语义演化的新基准。TTGBench 包含六个具有“双重波动性”（Dual Volatility）特征的真实世界、文本丰富的数据集，能够对现有模型进行严格而公平的评估。值得注意的是，它是首个同时支持……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: TTGBench 是首个联合评估文本属性时序图中结构演化与语义漂移的新基准，通过六个具有“双重波动性”特征的真实文本丰富数据集，解决了现有基准忽视语义演化以及链路重复导致性能虚高的问题。
en_tdlr: TTGBench is the first benchmark that jointly evaluates both structural evolution and semantic drift in text-attributed temporal graphs, featuring six real-world text-rich datasets with Dual Volatility to overcome existing benchmarks' neglect of semantic evolution and inflated performance estimates caused by high link repetition.
